verdict_text:
NO

The script drops head 6 (`DROP_HEAD = 6`), but the specification's "Required result" says to remove head 5 from every layer. With head 6 removed, the fused projection keeps rows 0..4607 and 5376..6143 instead of the required 0..3839 and 4608..6143 (clauses 1 and 2), and the dense weight keeps columns 0..1535 and 1792..2047 instead of 0..1279 and 1536..2047 (clause 3). The shape checks still pass because any single dropped head yields the required shapes, so the script cannot detect the error. Also, the script imports `load_checkpoint` from a helper module `_ckpt` that is not part of the artifact and may not exist in the sandbox, and it takes its output path from an optional command-line argument rather than fixing it to `out/T2` (clause 5), though the default is correct.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
